shared_elements: head occupying upper portion of the field
circular disc/ornament on the chest or body
sets of parallel incised lines forming a banded or feathered area
justification: Both present a single anthropomorphic figure incised in shallow relief on a rounded-cornered stone field, with a large headdress filling the upper zone, a circular ear ornament beside the face, a prominent disc on the chest and fans of parallel lines below — a fairly specific repeated set of motifs. The biggest differences are scale and orientation: A is a massive weathered monolith whose figure is shown frontally with worn, softened contours, while B is a small smooth tablet with a crisp profile head and clean, continuous grooved outlines.
